title: Atlas and Letter
author: Odile Galloway
blurb: Silas Marchetti, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
